response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS per_gender_average FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_orders) AS average_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.invoiced_orders - o.per_gender_average) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.invoiced_orders > o.per_gender_average;
